'''Piedmont Natural Gas Sutton Pipeline''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.power-eng.com/gas/turbines/natural-gas-pipeline-finished-near-power-plant-site/|title=power-eng.com|website=power-eng.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Hamlet, North Carolina to Sutton Plant, North Carolina.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.smeinc.com/?p=1690|title=smeinc.com|website=smeinc.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.power-eng.com/gas/turbines/natural-gas-pipeline-finished-near-power-plant-site/|title=power-eng.com|website=power-eng.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
*'''Owner: '''Piedmont Natural Gas<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.power-eng.com/gas/turbines/natural-gas-pipeline-finished-near-power-plant-site/|title=power-eng.com|website=power-eng.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''128 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.power-eng.com/gas/turbines/natural-gas-pipeline-finished-near-power-plant-site/|title=power-eng.com|website=power-eng.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''20, 30 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.power-eng.com/gas/turbines/natural-gas-pipeline-finished-near-power-plant-site/|title=power-eng.com|website=power-eng.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.power-eng.com/gas/turbines/natural-gas-pipeline-finished-near-power-plant-site/|title=power-eng.com|website=power-eng.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
